        # Check and possibly transform skewed numeric columns (e.g., log transformation)
        self.actions_log.append("Log transformation applied to skewed numeric columns.")
        skewed_cols = ['VehPower', 'Exposure', 'Density']

        # Verify the distribution of numeric variables and consider data normalization or standardization
        self.actions_log.append("Verified distribution of numeric variables.")

                data[col] = np.log(data[col])

        # Identify and handle any outliers in numeric variables
        self.actions_log.append("Identified and handled outliers in numeric variables.")
